description:
THE LAST FLIGHT 2026 is an independent project focused on bringing NASA's forgotten robotic explorers to life through interactive storytelling and educational experiences.

Our goal is to make space exploration fascinating and easy to understand through creative animations, scientific research, interactive timelines, and engaging digital experiences.

We aim to inspire young learners to explore the wonders of space and understand the achievements of past NASA missions.
summary:
THE LAST FLIGHT 2026 is an interactive storytelling website about NASA's Ingenuity Mars Helicopter, created for the challenge "Abandoned but not Forgotten."

The project explores Ingenuity's historic journey, from its first powered flight on Mars in April 2021 to its final flight in January 2024. Through a visual timeline, mission facts, informative sections, and an interactive quiz, the website helps visitors understand why Ingenuity was left on Mars and why its achievements still matter.

The project aims to make space exploration history accessible and engaging while highlighting how abandoned equipment can continue to inspire future scientific discoveries. Although Ingenuity can no longer fly, its legacy lives on.
details:
THE LAST FLIGHT 2026 is an interactive storytelling website created for the NASA Space Apps Challenge 2026. It focuses on NASA's Ingenuity Mars Helicopter and its remarkable journey on Mars.

The website tells the story of Ingenuity, from its first powered, controlled flight on another planet on April 19, 2021, to its final flight on January 18, 2024. It explains the helicopter's achievements, the challenges it faced, why its mission ended, and how its legacy can inspire future space exploration.

The project includes an introduction to the mission, important facts, a visual timeline, explanations of Ingenuity's final mission, and an interactive quiz. These features make the information engaging and easier for visitors to understand.

The main benefit of this project is that it makes space exploration history accessible to a wider audience, especially students and young learners. It encourages curiosity about planetary exploration and shows that even equipment that can no longer operate can leave behind valuable scientific knowledge and inspiration.

The website was developed using HTML, CSS, and JavaScript. Visual Studio Code was used for coding, and Netlify was used to publish the website.

The creative aspect of the project is its combination of storytelling, a visual timeline, and an interactive quiz. Instead of presenting only facts, it allows visitors to explore Ingenuity's journey in an engaging way.

The project focuses on accuracy, simplicity, accessibility, and educational value. Its intended impact is to preserve the story of Ingenuity and inspire people to explore the history and future of space exploration.
